constraints.canonical_text: Scrip dividend alternatives shall be taken in cash by default; a scrip election requires a documented rationale from the portfolio manager and is not permitted for this Fund.
Rights issues shall be taken up by default; a decision to let rights lapse or to sell nil-paid rights requires a documented rationale from the portfolio manager.
Tender offers shall be declined by default; tendering requires approval of the Chief Investment Officer.
Elections shall be instructed to the custodian no later than 2 business days before the custodian deadline.
In recent years the majority of scrip alternatives offered to the Fund have been taken in cash.
Exposure to any single securities lending or repo counterparty shall not exceed 10% of net asset value.
No transaction may be entered into with an entity affiliated with the Manager; this conflict-of-interest prohibition cannot be overridden by any individual or committee.
Cash deposits may only be placed with banks rated A- or better.
No single executing broker shall account for more than 25% of the Fund's annual traded value.
Securities lending exposure to the largest counterparty is currently about 5% of net asset value.
Gross notional exposure through derivatives shall not exceed 50% of net asset value.
Mark-to-market exposure to any single derivatives counterparty shall not exceed 10% of net asset value.
Derivatives may only be transacted with counterparties rated A- or better by at least one recognised rating agency.
Uncollateralised derivatives exposure shall not exceed 5% of net asset value.
Derivatives may be used for hedging purposes only; derivatives that increase market exposure are prohibited.
Over the last three years gross notional derivatives exposure has typically been around 20% of net asset value.

Issuers involved in the production of controversial weapons (cluster munitions, anti-personnel mines, biological and chemical weapons) are excluded absolutely; no exception may be granted by any person.
Issuers deriving more than 30% of revenue from thermal coal are excluded, unless the security is a certified green bond whose proceeds are ring-fenced for transition projects.
